mapper.select: SELECT MOVIE_ID, POSTER_URL, TITLE, MOVIE_RATING, TO_CHAR(OPEN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS OPEN_DATE, OPEN_COUNTRY, RUNNING_TIME, INTRODUCE, SYNOPSIS, ORIGINAL_TITLE, STATE, "LANGUAGE", BUDGET, PROFIT FROM MOVIE
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'MV-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_MOVIE_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TMDB.MOVIE (MOVIE_ID, POSTER_URL, TITLE, MOVIE_RATING, OPEN_DATE, OPEN_COUNTRY, RUNNING_TIME, INTRODUCE, SYNOPSIS, ORIGINAL_TITLE, STATE, "LANGUAGE", BUDGET, PROFIT) VALUES(#{movieId}, #{posterUrl}, #{title}, #{movieRating}, #{openDate}, #{openCountry}, 0, #{introduce}, #{synopsis}, #{originalTitle}, #{state}, #{language}, 0, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT M.MOVIE_ID, M.POSTER_URL, M.TITLE, M.MOVIE_RATING, TO_CHAR(M.OPEN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS OPEN_DATE, M.OPEN_COUNTRY, M.RUNNING_TIME, M.INTRODUCE, M.SYNOPSIS, M.ORIGINAL_TITLE, M.STATE, M."LANGUAGE", M.BUDGET, M.PROFIT, F.FILE_NUM, F.FILE_GROUP_ID, F.OBFUSCATE_NAME, F.DISPLAY_NAME, F.EXTEND_NAME, F.FILE_LENGTH, F.FILE_PATH FROM MOVIE M LEFT OUTER JOIN FILES F ON M.MOVIE_ID = F.FILE_GROUP_ID WHERE M.MOVIE_ID = #{_parameter}
